spans.s: रुश् r. 6th cl. (रुशति) To hurt or kill. (इ) रुशि r. 10th cl. (रुंशयति) To shine.

रुष् r. 1st cl. (रोषति) r. 4th cl. (रुष्यति-ते)
 1. To hurt, to injure, to kill or
attempt to kill.
 2. To vex. (इर्) रुषिर् r. 4th and 10th cls. (रुष्यति-ते
रोषयति-ते) To be angry to be passionate or wrathful.

रुष् f. (-रुट्) Anger, wrath, passion.
 E. रुष् to be angry, aff. क्विप्; also
with टाप् added, रुषा f. (-षा) ।

रूष् r. 1st cl. (रूषति)
 1. To decorate, to adorn.
 2. To smear, to cover
with dust. r. 10th cl. (रूपयति-ते)
 1. To tremble.
 2. To burst.

रुशत् mfn. (-शन्-शती or शन्ती-शत्)
 1. Maledictory, imprecative.
 2. Cursing
imprecating.
 E. रुश् to seek, to injure, aff. शतृ ।

रुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Enraged, angry.
 E. रुष् to be angry, aff. क्त with इट् augment.

रूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Pounded, reduced to dust or powder.
 2.
Covered, spread over, coated, inlaid.
 3. Adorned, decorated.
 4.
Made rough or rugged.
 E. रूष् to adorn, aff. क्त ।

रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Angry, enraged.
 E. रुष् to be angry, aff. क्त ।

रुष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Wrath, rage, anger.
 E. रुष् to be angry, क्तिन् aff.

रूषक m. (-कः) A plant, (Justicia ganderussa.)
 E. रूष् to adorn, aff. क्वुन् ।
